# **This is a series competition with [Ohio State Spring Gray 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateSpringGray2023). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Ohio State Spring Gray 2023, your registration for this competition will be rejected.**

This competition will take place in Meeting Rooms #1-3 in the RPAC.
